title: SB6406 (2019-2020 Regular): Concerning firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Comm Sub, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/6406-S.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Version read: Substitute (Comm Sub) SB 6406, 2019-20; not enrolled. Sec. 2 adds the new crime to the sentencing seriousness list (rest of RCW 9.94A.515 is reprinted existing law); the seriousness level number sits in a table not visible in the text, so it is not quoted.

operative_text:
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new section, chapter 9A.56 RCW): (1) A person is guilty of theft of a firearm from a residence, store, shop, sales outlet, or vehicle if he or she commits a theft of any firearm from a residence, store, shop, or sales outlet where firearms are sold, or from any vehicle.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new section, chapter 9A.56 RCW): (2) This section applies regardless of the value of the firearm taken in the theft.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new section, chapter 9A.56 RCW): (3) Each firearm taken in the theft under this section is a separate offense.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new section, chapter 9A.56 RCW): (6) Theft of a firearm from a residence, store, shop, sales outlet, or vehicle is a class B felony.
Sec. 2 (RCW 9.94A.515): Theft of a firearm from a residence, store, shop, sales outlet, or vehicle (section 1 of this act)
